claimReferencePolicy.rule: Claims must cite the normalized sourceId and citationKey. Git sources require a full commit, academic sources require the indexed paper/year, community reports require the exact page URL and report date, and firmware artifacts remain unverified until locally hashed.
prohibited: Do not cite a generic repository home page when an exact commit is available.
Do not use a community report as implementation proof.
Do not treat a paper description as a code, model, dataset or patent licence.
Do not treat an OTA URL token, archive tag or Git object ID as a partition SHA-256.
Do not silently transfer findings across SoCs, operating systems, firmware builds or camera package versions.
